healthBenefits.title: Rich in Omega-3
healthBenefits.text: Fresh anchovies are an excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids, supporting heart and brain health.

healthBenefits.title: High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies provide lean, easily digestible protein essential for muscle repair and growth.

healthBenefits.title: Bone Support
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies contain calcium and vitamin D, contributing to healthy bones and teeth.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil offers monounsaturated fats and antioxidants that help protect cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Boost
healthBenefits.text: Cherry tomatoes supply vitamin C and lycopene, which help combat oxidative stress.

healthBenefits.title: Sustained Energy
healthBenefits.text: Spaghetti provides complex carbohydrates for steady, long-lasting energy release.

_ingredientsText:
300g spaghetti
300g fresh anchovies
6 cherry tomatoes
1 tablespoon chopped parsley
1 clove of garlic
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
½ glass of white wine
salt
_preparationText:
Clean the anchovies and remove the bone as well. Rinse them and set aside.
In a pan, put the cherry tomatoes cut in half, the crushed garlic, the parsley and the oil.
Cook for 10 minutes and add half a glass of white wine.
Let the wine reduce and add the anchovies cut into small pieces.
Cook for a further 5 minutes and remove the garlic.
Separately, cook the pasta, drain it al dente and tip it into the pan.
Stir over a high heat for a moment to let the flavours combine, then serve garnished with chopped parsley.
